name: 43169-multiimage-26b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration -- a sparse mixture-of-experts text decoder (30 layers, 128 experts, top-8, hidden 2816) with a vision tower in front of it; images enter the decoder as up to 280 soft tokens each. bf16, ~49 GB of weights.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), two rates in one run -- 7 requests/s scored, then 3 requests/s as the source's nominal point -- 300 requests each, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 1800 s safety cap, static seed 43169. 7 is the source's 3 requests/s translated onto 2x H100: the source's rate sat ~25% above its own A100 capacity, and holding that ratio on this hardware is what preserves the regime.
workload: one `synthetic_text` entry -- 50 prompt tokens, 10 output tokens, min == max on both, temperature 0 -- plus six `synthetic_image` entries of one 480x480 jpeg each (quality 85, gradient content) carrying distinct seeds 4801..4806, which is how six distinct images reach a single turn.
purpose: A multimodal assistant answering six-image questions on a 26-billion-parameter model across two GPUs at several requests per second.
launch:
model: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it
tensor-parallel-size: 2

# `video: 0` is deliberate: a modality left unset defaults to 999 and lets the startup
# profiler reserve memory for items this workload never sends. Keep this on one line.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 6, "video": 0}

max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
